$about: Switch: a track and a thumb. On or off, effective at once. Every value is a token reference, a plain number (a set value in px, not a token), 'none' or a rule (D-025). Status draft: the owner may still change it.
title: Switch
anatomy: A row: [track with thumb] [label + description], or [label + description] [track] when the label is on the left. The track is a rounded well; the thumb slides inside it. The whole row is the click target.

rules.states: Off, on; each at rest, hover, pressed, focus and disabled. Off is a well: fill/primary track with border/secondary, and a content/secondary thumb. On is fill/inverse (white, like shadcn's primary, D-038) with a content/inverse-primary thumb. Orange stays for the one main action (D-003).
rules.hover: Hover is the -hover fill and border of the track's own family (D-035); the off thumb lights to content/primary. Pressed is one step stronger, the -active fill and border. Hover and press work on the whole row, label included. Nothing moves or changes size: the border is an inset box-shadow.
rules.shade: No inner shade, unlike Button: at 16–20px the shade greys the white out, so on stays a flat, solid fill that pops (D-041). The track is a lit surface (D-020).
rules.motion: The thumb slides from one end of the track to the other, duration/base, easing/standard (D-031). Track colour and thumb colour change at duration/fast. The first paint never animates. Reduced motion: no slide, the thumb and track fade to the new state.
rules.size: sm: track 28 x 16, thumb 12. md: track 36 x 20, thumb 16. md is the default. The thumb sits 2 from the track's edge on every side. The thumb's travel is the track width minus the thumb minus 4. Text is the same in both: label body/md/regular, description body/sm/regular.
rules.label: Right of the switch by default. On the left (labelPosition start), the row can span the full width (block) so the switch sits at the far edge, as in a settings list.
rules.colours: Label content/primary, description content/tertiary. Disabled: label content/primary-disabled, description content/tertiary-disabled, track -disabled fill and border, thumb content/primary-disabled; a disabled on track uses fill/secondary-disabled, like a disabled primary Button, because fill/inverse-disabled is the same grey as the thumb.
rules.focus: Keyboard focus (focus-visible only) draws a ring outside the track: border/focus, stroke/2. The row never clips it. A scroll or clip container around a switch keeps stroke/2 of room (D-037).
rules.hit: The visible track is smaller than size/target (44) in height, and in width too. An invisible layer around the track makes the hit area at least 44 x 44 without moving anything. The label and description are part of the click target too.
rules.keyboard: Tab reaches each switch. Space toggles it. Enter does not. A disabled switch leaves the Tab order.
rules.aria: A native input type=checkbox with role=switch, so it works in forms and is announced as on or off. The label names it (aria-labelledby), the description describes it (aria-describedby). With no visible label, pass aria-label.
rules.use: Use a switch for a setting that takes effect the moment it changes, like turning a feature on. Use a Checkbox when a choice waits for a Save or Submit button, or when several options can be picked. The label names what is on ('Auto-save'), so on and off both read right; never label a switch with an action.
rules.light: The track is lit by light/cursor (D-020). The thumb sits inside it, so it is covered; the label is plain text and is not.

track.$about: The rounded well. Width is a set value (the height is an icon frame).

thumb.$about: The slider inside the track: track height minus 2 x padding.

off.$about: A well: darker than the surface it sits on.
